description: This file defines the ArrowFunctionExpression class in Twig, representing an arrow (lambda) function expression within Twig templates, including methods for compiling this expression into executable PHP code.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\ArrowFunctionExpression
classes.description: Represents an arrow function expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, providing methods to compile the node into PHP code for rendering templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the arrow function expression with its sub-expressions and node information.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the arrow function expression into PHP code, handling the function signature, variable scope, and return statement.
